findings.candidate_quote: 46% were asymptomatic or in remission by 2003
findings.reference_quote:
Of the 12 patients not receiving pharmacological treatment
(46%), 7 (27%) were asymptomatic and fulfilled criteria for complete remission. The remaining 5 patients
had mild persistent symptoms, primarily ocular, but did not require ongoing pharmacological therapy at
the time of evaluation.
findings.explanation: The summary conflates absence of medication with absence of symptoms or remission. Only 27% were asymptomatic and in complete remission; the 46% also included five patients with persistent symptoms. This materially overstates the cohort's favorable clinical outcome.
